visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black cap, black t-shirt, and black pants stands on an asphalt path next to a chain-link fence, facing a woman in a flowing cream-colored dress. They are holding hands and gazing at one another under a clear blue sky with sparse clouds. (2) A large commercial airplane with a white fuselage and red tail markings flies extremely low directly above the couple. As the plane passes over them, the man and woman move closer and share a romantic kiss in the center of the path. (3) The camera angle changes to a medium shot from behind the man's shoulder. The woman's arms are wrapped around his neck in a hug. The man holds a vertical strip of three black-and-white ultrasound photos clearly visible against his back, while a city skyline with a prominent skyscraper is seen in the distance.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 man and 1 woman appearing together throughout the scene.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The man is dressed in a black t-shirt, black baseball cap, black pants, and white sneakers. The woman wears a long, loose-fitting sleeveless cream-colored dress and light-colored flats.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A paved path bounded by a chain-link fence on the left and a grassy field on the right. In the distance, urban buildings and a tall iconic skyscraper (Taipei 101) are visible against a bright sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A rhythmic, bright acoustic guitar begins strumming with high clarity. There is no background noise or environmental interference, creating a studio-clean atmosphere. (2) A male singer with a gentle, breathy vocal quality begins the lyrics 'I just love you.' The acoustic guitar maintains a steady slow-to-moderate tempo. Despite the visual presence of a low-flying aircraft, no engine noise is audible in the track. (3) The vocal continues with the melodic phrase 'It's the best thing that I'll ever do,' maintaining a consistent conversational loudness. The guitar strums continue until the track fades out cleanly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative and sentimental pregnancy announcement. It uses a visually dramatic moment of an airplane flying overhead to symbolize a monumental life event, culminating in the reveal of ultrasound photos to share news of the couple's expanding family.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a popular social media trend of filming near airport runways for a cinematic reveal. The presence of Taipei 101 firmly establishes the location in Taiwan.
